description: List the Uber products available at a given location.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location to list products for.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location to list products for.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'products' list of product objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single Uber product by its product_id.

product_id.description: The unique id of the product (e.g. uberx).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the product object; on failure (product not found), output contains an error message.

description: Estimate ride prices across products for a start and end location.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'prices' list of price estimate objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Estimate pickup ETAs across products for a pickup location.

product_id.description: Optional product id to restrict the estimate to a single product.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a 'times' list of ETA estimate objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create a new ride request for a product with a start (and optional end) location.

product_id.description: The product id to request the ride for.

end_latitude.description: Optional latitude of the drop-off location.

end_longitude.description: Optional longitude of the drop-off location.

rider_id.description: Optional rider id; defaults to the current rider profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created ride request (trip) object; on failure (product not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single ride request (trip) by its request_id.

request_id.description: The unique id of the ride request.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the ride request object; on failure (request not found), output contains an error message.

description: Cancel a ride request by its request_id.

request_id.description: The unique id of the ride request to cancel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated (canceled) ride request; on failure (not found or not cancelable), output contains an error message.

description: List the rider's completed trip history with pagination.

rider_id.description: Optional rider id to filter history by.

limit.description: Maximum number of history entries to return (default 50).

offset.description: Number of history entries to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with count, limit, offset, and a 'history' list; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the rider profile object; on failure, output contains an error message.
